quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the impact of the NBA collective bargaining agreement on team building
quotes.excerpt: The CBA has put teams in a bind where if you have these guys making over 300 million dollars.
quotes.quote: The CBA has put teams in a bind where if you have these guys making over 300 million dollars, it cripples your basketball team. It's tough to move when you have so much money spent on two players. If you have that, you cannot build out a roster that can compete with the Oklahoma City Thunders, with the San Antonios, with the Knicks. It's not possible.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the difficulty of building a roster around two max contracts
quotes.excerpt: If you have these guys that are both making over 300 million dollars, it cripples your basketball team.
quotes.quote: If you have these guys that are both making over 300 million dollars, it cripples your basketball team. It's tough to move when you have so much money spent on two players. If you have that, you cannot build out a roster that can compete with the Oklahoma City Thunders, with the San Antonios, with the Knicks. It's not possible. You saw it this year. At the end of the day, you can develop all the young core you can, but you're going to continue to have to play guys who have never been in that experience.
